minor_findings.finding: Thin dark truss/wind-sensor strokes have low contrast against the dark background, especially at900x600. Their shapes remain visible; not missing meshes or palette bleed.

office_panel_layout.observation: New motion-reduction and route buttons fit in the office side panel; this screenshot inspection does not independently retest their events.

limits: This pass concerns visible regions at actual1440x900 and900x600 captures in Windows Chrome SwiftShader; arbitrary camera zoom/angles, physical GPUs and mobile devices are separate.

Small white-on-white vessels, tiny buttons/keys/labels/antennas and occluded rear/underside parts cannot each be distinguished in reduced browser frames; specific per-room limits are recorded. Component319 proof retains individual three-direction views.

No visible palette-cell bleed, unexpected saturated patch or material tint mismatch was found at the displayed scales. This is an observed target-display judgment, not a guarantee for every hidden surface or every possible filtering environment.
Thin strokes may alias or lose contrast at900px; this is retained as a nonblocking visibility observation rather than mislabeled palette bleed.
No specialist medical/industrial functionality or fine iconographic accuracy is certified.
Office functional acceptance, native Play results and performance belong to separate actual test evidence; this visual report does not replace those tests.
